summary: Selected the highest-priority runnable DXVK follow-up from the durable prior checkpoint: Set 09 F31/F32 post-launch diagnostic survivability. The runner now captures launch/wait and host-teardown failures into RUNNER_FAILURE.json, restores process environment, invokes diagnostic collection before propagating those failures, and uses a non-destructive emergency collector snapshot when outrun-vr-host cannot be terminated. Emergency collection permits the stuck-process diagnostic case, produces the session ZIP, and deliberately preserves root logs/captures and CURRENT_VR_SESSION.json without rotating to a new session. Added Windows behavior regression coverage and wired it into the one-click Backend Conversion Gate. No renderer/provider ownership or vr-d3d9ex-focus changes were made.

Set 09 S09-R01/F31 documented that Start-Process exceptions bypassed post-game host wait and collector invocation; S09-R03/F32 documented that a host surviving forced teardown threw before collector invocation.

Run-OutRunVRTest.ps1 now stores GAME_LAUNCH_OR_WAIT or HOST_TEARDOWN failure evidence in the active session, restores environment first, performs diagnostic collection, and only then propagates the original failure.

Collect-OutRunVRLogs.ps1 -Emergency allows a stuck-process snapshot but marks LogBoundary=emergency-snapshot-running-process and EmergencySnapshot=true, does not delete copied source logs/captures, and does not rotate CURRENT_VR_SESSION.json or prepare a next session.

Test-RunOutRunVRFailureDiagnostics.ps1 behavior-tests an invalid executable Start-Process failure and verifies collection occurred before failure propagation. It also behavior-tests emergency collection is non-destructive, preserves the current session, emits the emergency manifest and creates exactly one ZIP.
